text:
oncall-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PD#INC-3247 — metrics-pipeline > log-ingest-consumer-lag high. link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/INC-3247 (auto-page to eng-sre)
alyssa.sre: acked. I'm on it. seeing duplicated alerts for prometheus scrape failures too? :thinking:
miguel.platform: I can pull the metrics — give me 30s. suspected origin: kafka consumer group falling behind after a spike in log volume this morning.
alyssa.sre: checking consumer lag first. run: ```docker exec -it kafka-tools kafka-consumer-groups.sh --bootstrap-server kafka-1:9092 --describe --group log-ingest-consumers``` results: "CURRENT-OFFSET 1249810, LOG-END-OFFSET 12550000, LAG 11200190" — massive lag.
alyssa.sre: also queried Prometheus: ```sum(rate(prometheus_tsdb_head_samples_appended_total[5m])) by (job)``` shows scrape flaps for exporters on nodepool-b.
miguel.platform: looks like ingesters scaled down earlier and couldn't keep up with burst. autoscaler config shows minReplicas=1, maxReplicas=5, current=1.
alyssa.sre: I'm going to restart a consumer pod to relieve backlog and scale up consumers. doing: ```kubectl scale deployment/log-ingest-consumers --replicas=4 -n infra-logging``` — will tail logs after.
sre-runbook-bot: Runbook check: "If consumer lag > 1M, warn and scale out. If >10M, consider fallback routing to backup topic and alert platform." https://runbooks.internal/log-ingest-backup
oncall-bot: PD note: INC-3247 assigned to alyssa.sre, escalation policy: pager -> sms after 10m.
alyssa.sre: pod restart complete. tailing logs:
```
2026-11-05T16:18:03Z info consumer [shard-3] processing at 12510234
2026-11-05T16:18:06Z warn processing lag: 9.8e6
```
alyssa.sre: lag dropped to ~7.2M after scale. still high but progressing.
nina-support: any customer-visible impact? Support seeing delayed log delivery for 3 customers (acct ids redacted). CS is on it.
miguel.platform: creating temporary throttle for non-critical tenants to preserve throughput. patch:
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
data:
  tenant-rate-limits: |
    non_critical: 10 req/s
    critical: 200 req/s
```
kubectl apply -f tenant-rate-limits.yaml -n infra-logging
```
alyssa.sre: also enabling backup-routing via broker topic "logs-backup" — using mirror connector to route older messages while main backlog drains. command:
```
kafka-connect-cli create-connector --config backup-route.json
```
sre-runbook-bot: Reminder: postmortem required for >4h customer impact or >5M avg lag. See template: https://runbooks.internal/postmortem-template
jordan.sre: pinging @alyssa.sre — I'm taking next shift in 20m. if you need handoff, summarize action items.
alyssa.sre: handoff summary for @jordan.sre: 1) consumers scaled to 4, observing lag down to 6.5M and decreasing ~200k/min. 2) backup-route enabled, non-critical tenants throttled. 3) monitoring: grafana panel "ingest.consumer_lag" alert threshold lowered to 2M. 4) PD incident open INC-3247, SLA: potential partial delay for logs (< 2h expected to recover). logs of tail and commands in thread.
jordan.sre: got it. will watch metrics and be ready to scale further or flip traffic to backup topic if lag plateau > 30m. @ops-schedule FYI for any cross-team escalations.
ops-schedule: noted. paging rotation updated, will escalate to platform team if we hit consumer OOMs.
alyssa.sre: quick customer impact note: affected customers see log arrival delays (median ~18m, peak ~2h). no query failures, just ingestion delay. support notified and templated status posted.
oncall-bot: PagerDuty update: INC-3247 status -> acknowledged by alyssa.sre at 2026-11-05T16:22:10Z
miguel.platform: verifying Prometheus scrapes stabilized after scaling. prometheus query: ```up{job="node-exporter", pool="nodepool-b"}``` shows majority back to 1.
alyssa.sre: lag trending down: 6.1M -> 4.5M over 40m. if rate holds we'll be below alert threshold in ~2.5h. continuing to monitor.
nina-support: posting interim customer update: "We're seeing delayed ingestion for logs; teams are working to drain backlog. No data loss expected." :white_check_mark:
jordan.sre: small thing — I saw occasional consumer OOM logs before restart. suggest bumping JVM heap to 6G for consumer pods in next infra deploy. filing infra ticket.
alyssa.sre: filed infra-ticket-852 in tracker, link: https://jira.internal/browse/INFRA-852
sre-runbook-bot: If incident extends >2h, start collecting eval prompts/queries to check data fidelity post-drain.
alyssa.sre: final update — backlog drained below 500k, consumer lag at 420k. flipping PD to resolved soon.
oncall-bot: PagerDuty update: INC-3247 -> resolved by alyssa.sre at 2026-11-05T18:03:40Z
alyssa.sre: resolved. follow-up items: update HPA min replicas to 2 for log-ingest-consumers, JVM heap bump, refine alert thresholds to avoid noisier alerts. I'll draft postmortem and assign owners.
jordan.sre: :thumbsup: Thanks all. I'll pick up monitoring this hour. filing note to runbook: add backup-route test to canary plan.
nina-support: thanks team — customers updated and CS will keep watch. :pray:
sre-runbook-bot: Postmortem template prefilled: https://runbooks.internal/postmortems/INC-3247 (assigned to alyssa.sre)
